title: Words to read and colour: Madd and shaddah reading practice
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 42 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 42. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Madd and shaddah reading practice). Then trace and copy.

questions.a: an-naas: press the noon, stretch the alif.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read eight words; colour shaddahs yellow and madd letters green. The teacher listens to today's group.

options: press the laam and stretch the alif
questions.a: A) press the laam and stretch the alif. Shaddah on laam, then alif madd.

questions.q: Think again: Which is harder to remember: stretching the madd or pressing the shaddah? Why?
questions.a: Any answer: we practise both until they are easy.
